scope: Current Florence Y’all Water Tower by Florence Mall, with ribbed cylindrical column, painted flared water tank and its measured crown.

originalReview.notes: Shows sixteen alternating red and white sectors continuing over the cap, a two-line sign, thin crown fittings and an off-white ribbed shaft.

quallaSearch.notes: The one usable exterior already on Qualla byte-matches the photographer’s own exact Commons image and signed CC0 dedication. The image establishes the two-color stripe layout and face-on interstate lettering.
